title: Don't Solve, Just Compare: Tiny Advisors for Runtime Intervention in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.21027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are emerging as an important paradigm for real-world tasks that require reasoning, tool use, and sequential decision-making. As these agents operate over longer horizons, runtime intervention offers a way to improve reliability without retraining the underlying actor. Failure detection alone is insufficient. Effective intervention must also provide a useful direction for recovery. Existing approaches often rely on an expert solver or a critic that generates task-specific corrections, incurring either the cost of another capable solver or the capacity demands of a task-capable critic. We introduce Comparison-Only Tiny Advisor (COTA), a comparison-only framework for constructive runtime intervention. In COTA, a tiny comparator judges whether sampled alternatives lead to better continuations than the actor's proposal, and repeated comparisons determine when intervention is warranted. translated_title: 不要解决，只需比较：用于LLM代理运行时干预的微型顾问
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21027v1 公告类型：新 摘要：LLM代理正成为需要推理、工具使用和顺序决策的现实世界任务的重要范式。随着这些代理在更长的时间跨度上运行，运行时干预提供了一种无需重新训练底层执行器即可提高可靠性的方法。仅靠故障检测是不够的。有效的干预还必须提供有用的恢复方向。现有方法通常依赖专家求解器或生成任务特定纠正的批评者，这要么需要另一个强大求解器的成本，要么需要任务级批评者的容量需求。我们引入了比较仅微型顾问（COTA），这是一种用于建设性运行时干预的比较仅框架。在COTA中，一个微型比较器判断采样备选方案是否比执行器的提议产生更好的延续，重复比较决定何时需要干预。我们使用成对监督训练比较器。
tldr: COTA通过仅使用微型比较器进行成对比较，无需额外强大求解器或大型批评者，即可在运行时检测并纠正LLM代理的错误，提高可靠性。
en_tdlr: COTA enables runtime intervention in LLM agents by using a tiny comparator with pairwise comparisons, avoiding the need for an expert solver or a large critic, thereby improving reliability efficiently.
